name: friday-one-gateway
description: FRIDAY One realtime gateway — authenticated WSS hub between Android clients and connectors. Single instance; durable state lives in Firestore.

scripts.test: npm run build && node agents-test.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase/firebase.json --project demo-friday-one --only auth,firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/gateway.test.mjs"
